1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate letter and line spacing on the sign-in form.

2.why: Visible text avoids italics, all-caps, and dense blocks; copy is short and regular-weight.

3.why: Layout is a single narrow card with clear fields and button, appearing readable at mobile width.

4.why: Instructions such as “Confirm your account details before setting up payment security” are short and plain.

5.why: Placeholders explicitly show example email and phone values, and a note tells the user to use them.

6.why: No long text blocks appear; the screen only has brief labels, one sentence, and a button.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are shown anywhere in the screenshots, so copy support cannot be observed.

8.why: No QR code or alternative to manual entry appears on any of the provided screens.

9.why: Standard email/tel inputs are present and pre-filled, suggesting possible autofill, but password-manager support is not demonstrated.

10.why: The heading “Sign in to continue” and the large blue Continue button make the step and primary action clear.

11.why: Only one main action (Continue) is presented on the screen at a time.

12.why: After Continue the only feedback is a vague error; it does not plainly state what happened or what comes next.

13.why: Retry is possible via the error’s “Please try again,” but no codes are shown to reveal/hide/re-request.

14.why: The error “We could not complete that request. Please try again” neither explains the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: No time limits or countdowns are visible on the screens for reading or entry.
